description: Recompute an evaluation's total from the scores it already has, under other aggregation rules: a what-if that calls no judge. Returns the summary with the new total, grade and pass/fail. Nothing is stored unless `persist` is true.

aggregation.description: The settings to apply, as in a rubric's `aggregation`: any of `method` (weighted_mean, weighted_sum, mean, median, min, max, geometric_mean, formula), `formula`, `gates`, `grades`, `passThreshold`. Settings left out stay as the rubric has them.

evaluationId.description: Id of the stored evaluation to recompute.

persist.description: true stores the new total on the evaluation; false, the default, only returns it.

name: reaggregate
title: Re-aggregate
